[b]Audio[/b]

[i]This chant may have interfered a bit with the neat song in Trixie scene[/i]

[list][*]SFX chant in Trixie's room now fades out when the music begins playing[/list]

[b]Bugfix[/b]

[i]Straight up bugs that are now squashed[/i]

[list][*]Leaving Ice Cave during sofcore mode could leave the snow effect on, this has been fixed.
[*]Fixed issue where gallery didn't count certain pics properly towards the achievement
[*]Game turned tutorials off by default regardless of what was chosen, this has been fixed.

[/list]
 
[i]See bellow for a reason[/i]

[i]A feature that had been requested makes return[/i]

[I]Since Day 1 Final Pancake has had problems that were massive, game breaking ones. It's about time we accept that some moves are just too awesome to be portrayed within videogames and move on.[/i]

[*]If you were taught Final Pancake in earlier version, passing through Gates of Heaven teaches you Final Fisting[/list]

[b]Balancing[/b]

[i]I noticed that after the previous update, the enemies didn't do their special moves enough, this rectifies that and other minor balance issues[/i]

[list][*]Adjusted the likelihood of Ungolia's Bone Crush
[*]Adjusted the likelihood of Lady of Ice's Absolute Zero and tied it to her needing to be 85% hp or lower for it to trigger
[*]Adjusted the likelihood of Jenna's Orbital Strike and tied it to her needing to be 50% hp or lower for it to trigger

notes.title: Sad news, the game won't be buyable for a while
notes.content:
Hello, fans and buyers of Save Your Mother. I come with very sad news for a time being.

[h1]Effective as of 5.2.2016, Save Your Mother will no longer be able to be purchased from the Steam store. If you find this game on sale during this time, it's a scam and I do not earn a single cent from it. Steam was the only place I sold the game at[/h1]


My reasons are personal and I would wish people to not pursue asking me about it, especially the ones who know me in real life. I will bring the game back sometime in the future, hopefully this year still. Maybe. This issue is major and affecting me on multiple levels, so I cannot make promises like that about when the game will return. Anyone who purchased the game earlier will keep the game of course and I wouldn't want anyone to take something that supported me through a hard time in my life away from them.


I am sorry for everyone who'd have wanted to buy the game under any of the number of the sales that'll happen this year but this is an absolute necessary and it really tears my heart and I wouldn't do this unless it was an absolute necessary. I worked on this game for over three years and dedicated so much of time, only to have to remove the game away because of issues that are out of my hands, especially when I had just barely broken even in my budget that had taken me years to pay up with my poor income. Once the game will be made purchasable, it'll most likely have a vastly reduced price for good.



Thank you for your support and understanding of this serious issue that has honestly, changed my entire life maybe forever.


Sincerely,
Tuomo Laine, creator of Save Your Mother.
